title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (JavaScript / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with comprehensive knowledge of JavaScript to join the software engineering team for our US-based client.

This client saves its customers millions of dollars providing engineering services, consulting, and software for complex, global projects in the renewable energy and oil and gas industries. The clients software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions provide key performance indicators for improved business decision making and workflows enabling inventory management, failure investigation reporting, and change management.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product management, product owner, and key stakeholders to gain approval of proposed architecture development plan
  • Lead the development effort (may include assisting in the hiring and onboarding of additional development and QA resources to assist)
  • Assure that implemented new capabilities meet the needs of the implementation team, customers, and product management
  • Follow common development standards and development methodologies to assure efficiency and high performance
  • Participate in team the code review process
  • Work closely with backend developers to ensure the integrity of the solution
  • Mentor junior developers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of JavaScript software development experience
  • Experience working in a .NET stack
  • Experience working with jQuery, Xamarin, and RESTful APIs
  • Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Ability to perform unit and integration testing for comprehensive code coverage
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies
  • Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
  • A positive attitude always looking to empower the success of others
  • Willingness to take ownership and find ways to unblock oneself
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Knockout or other JS frameworks
  • Experience with PWAs
  • Experience in UI/UX Design
  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

The clients software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions provide key performance indicators for improved business decision making and workflows enabling inventory management, failure investigation reporting, and change management.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product management, product owner, and key stakeholders to gain approval of proposed architecture development plan
  • Lead the development effort (may include assisting in the hiring and onboarding of additional development and QA resources to assist)
  • Assure that implemented new capabilities meet the needs of the implementation team, customers, and product management
  • Follow common development standards and development methodologies to assure efficiency and high performance
  • Participate in team the code review process
  • Work closely with backend developers to ensure the integrity of the solution
  • Mentor junior developers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of JavaScript software development experience
  • Experience working in a .NET stack
  • Experience working with jQuery, Xamarin, and RESTful APIs
  • Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Ability to perform unit and integration testing for comprehensive code coverage
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies
  • Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
  • A positive attitude always looking to empower the success of others
  • Willingness to take ownership and find ways to unblock oneself
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Knockout or other JS frameworks
  • Experience with PWAs
  • Experience in UI/UX Design
  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Application Support - Dynatrace (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;
  • Writing and executing SQL queries for data analysis and issue resolution;
  • Establishing best practices for application performance and monitoring;



What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Application Support, with at least 3 years of Dynatrace experience;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • SQL knowledge (other database experience is also considered);
  • Experience in Observability/Monitoring tools (Dynatrace preferred);
  • Java knowledge is a plus;
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Hybrid work model: available to work in Porto or Lisbon;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Analista Sênior de Planejamento Corporativo & Analytics
description:
Vaga: Analista Sênior de Planejamento Corporativo & Analytics

Local: Lapa – São Paulo | Presencial

Nível: Sênior


Se você transforma dados em decisões estratégicas, essa vaga é para você.

No nosso time de Planejamento Corporativo, os dados não são apenas números — são direcionadores de estratégia. Buscamos um(a) Analista Sênior de Planejamento Corporativo & Analytics para apoiar decisões executivas por meio de análises robustas, estruturação de indicadores e fortalecimento da governança da informação.

Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na consolidação de métricas corporativas, na construção de dashboards executivos e na elevação do nível analítico da organização, atuando de forma transversal com Comercial, Abastecimento, Supply Chain, Finanças e Digital.


Seus desafios no jogo:

• Apoiar a construção, manutenção e evolução de dashboards executivos, garantindo consistência, confiabilidade e clareza das informações;

• Desenvolver análises estratégicas de vendas, margem, CMV, estoque, giro, markdown e rentabilidade, com diferentes recortes (canal, loja, produto, categoria);

• Estruturar e padronizar indicadores corporativos, assegurando alinhamento de regras de negócio entre as áreas;

• Garantir a governança dos dados, participando da definição de fontes oficiais, validações, controles e documentação de processos analíticos;

• Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados, assegurando performance, qualidade e rastreabilidade das informações;

• Criar análises preditivas e apoiar processos de forecast, aderência e planejamento;

• Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, questionando premissas, propondo melhorias e elevando o nível crítico das decisões;

• Conectar informações de diferentes áreas para gerar uma visão corporativa integrada do desempenho da companhia;

• Contribuir para projetos de estruturação e evolução da área de Planejamento & Analytics.


O que esperamos de você:

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência sólida em Planejamento Corporativo, Planejamento Comercial, FP&A ou áreas analíticas estratégicas;

• Domínio avançado de Excel e Power BI;

• Experiência com SQL (preferencialmente BigQuery ou ambientes analíticos similares);

• Vivência com indicadores de negócio como vendas, margem, CMV, estoque, giro, markdown, forecast, aderência e rentabilidade;

• Forte capacidade analítica e experiência com grandes bases de dados;

• Perfil estruturado, criterioso e orientado à governança de regras de negócio;

• Comunicação clara e segurança para interagir com gerências e diretoria;

• Autonomia, senso de dono e responsabilidade sobre entregas estratégicas;

• Organização e disciplina para atuar com múltiplos projetos e stakeholders;

• Postura colaborativa, com visão corporativa e não departamental;

• Conforto em ambientes dinâmicos e em constante evolução.


⭐ Diferenciais:

• Experiência em varejo, bens de consumo ou ambientes multicanal;

• Vivência em processos de governança e padronização de indicadores corporativos;

• Experiência com planejamento de demanda, abastecimento ou forecast;

• Participação em projetos de estruturação ou reestruturação de áreas analíticas.

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.

title: Fullstack Java/kotlin/React Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58277



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvedor Full-Stack com sólida experiência em Java e Kotlin (backend) e React (frontend) para se juntar à nossa equipe. Esta vaga é ideal para alguém que trabalha bem com pouca supervisão, assume responsabilidades e consegue entregar soluções de alta qualidade de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente para conversação, escrita e leitura pois atenderá a grande empresa dos EUA do setor financeiro.
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • Horário: seg a sex das 10hs as 19hs, seguindo o calendário dos EUA.
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Mobile - Sênior (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Arquiteto de softwares sênior
description:
Arquiteto de softwares sênior

Requisitos Obrigatórios

Inglês Avançado

Experiência profunda em design de sistemas, com conhecimento em padrões arquiteturais como Microserviços, Event Driven, Serverless e Monólitos Modulares.

Essencial possuir domínio avançado em AWS, Azure ou GCP, focando em otimização de custos e alta disponibilidade. Proficiente em linguagens como Java, Go, .NET ou Python, com entendimento sobre quando utilizar bancos SQL vs NoSQL.

Conhecimento sólido em DevOps e Observabilidade, incluindo esteiras CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de monitoramento como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK.

Implementação de práticas de Security by Design, OAuth2 e LGPD são imprescindíveis.

Requisitos Desejáveis

Um histórico de contribuições em projetos Open Source e certificações de prestígio, como AWS Certified Solutions Architect.

Experiência com Domain Driven Design (DDD) é um plus.

Possuir habilidades de liderança e estratégia, incluindo o poder de articular conceitos técnicos complexos para stakeholders não técnicos.

Capacidade de mentoria e de elevar o nível técnico dos desenvolvedores plenos e seniores é desejada.

Pragmatismo e foco na entrega de valor são valorizados, assim como habilidades na resolução de conflitos técnicos entre equipes.

Resumo dos requisitos: Design de Sistemas, Microserviços, Event Driven, Serverless, Monólitos Modulares, AWS, Azure, GCP, Java, Go, .NET, Python, SQL, NoSQL, DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Security by Design, OAuth2, LGPD, Open Source, Domain Driven Design (DDD).

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Consultor(a) Tributário(a)


O(a) Consultor(a) Tributário(a) será responsável pelo atendimento consultivo aos clientes, analisando a realidade fiscal e tributária de cada empresa para identificar oportunidades de economia, recuperação de créditos e planejamento tributário.

Atuará diretamente na interpretação da legislação, análise de documentos fiscais, apoio na elaboração de estratégias tributárias e acompanhamento das demandas junto aos clientes, sempre com suporte da equipe técnica e jurídica.

A função envolve contato direto com empresários, apresentação de diagnósticos, esclarecimento de dúvidas e acompanhamento das soluções propostas, garantindo segurança jurídica e eficiência tributária.

  • Não é necessário ter domínio completo do tema desde o início: o(a) profissional contará com treinamento, suporte técnico e acompanhamento contínuo , possibilitando aprendizado prático e desenvolvimento na área consultiva tributária.


Remuneração: 3.250,00 + comissão.

O (a) Consultor(a) Tributário(a) recebe comissão sobre os contratos fechados .

Essa comissão é calculada sempre sobre o valor bruto do contrato , ou seja, antes de qualquer desconto, imposto ou custo .

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (JavaScript / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with comprehensive knowledge of JavaScript to join the software engineering team for our US-based client.

This client saves its customers millions of dollars providing engineering services, consulting, and software for complex, global projects in the renewable energy and oil and gas industries. The clients software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions provide key performance indicators for improved business decision making and workflows enabling inventory management, failure investigation reporting, and change management.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product management, product owner, and key stakeholders to gain approval of proposed architecture development plan
  • Lead the development effort (may include assisting in the hiring and onboarding of additional development and QA resources to assist)
  • Assure that implemented new capabilities meet the needs of the implementation team, customers, and product management
  • Follow common development standards and development methodologies to assure efficiency and high performance
  • Participate in team the code review process
  • Work closely with backend developers to ensure the integrity of the solution
  • Mentor junior developers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of JavaScript software development experience
  • Experience working in a .NET stack
  • Experience working with jQuery, Xamarin, and RESTful APIs
  • Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Ability to perform unit and integration testing for comprehensive code coverage
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies
  • Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
  • A positive attitude always looking to empower the success of others
  • Willingness to take ownership and find ways to unblock oneself
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Knockout or other JS frameworks
  • Experience with PWAs
  • Experience in UI/UX Design
  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Application Support - Dynatrace (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;

description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources.   • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)

  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net com IA
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend utilizando .NET / .NET Core (.NET 6+).

- Criar e evoluir APIs REST e/ou GraphQL, serviços e integrações.

- Aplicar boas práticas de Clean Code, SOLID, arquitetura em camadas e DDD.

- Integrar aplicações .NET com APIs de IA, LLMs e serviços de machine learning.

- VSCode

- .NET Framework

- DDD

- Unit Tests

- API REST

- Azure Cloud

title: Application Support - Dynatrace (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;
  • Writing and executing SQL queries for data analysis and issue resolution;
  • Establishing best practices for application performance and monitoring;



What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Application Support, with at least 3 years of Dynatrace experience;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • SQL knowledge (other database experience is also considered);
  • Experience in Observability/Monitoring tools (Dynatrace preferred);
  • Java knowledge is a plus;
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Hybrid work model: available to work in Porto or Lisbon;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Tech Lead - VTEX
description:
TECH LEAD - VTEX

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?


Você será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento e-commerce, garantindo a excelência na implementação de soluções na plataforma VTEX. Atuará como ponte entre as áreas técnicas e de negócios, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas escaláveis. Seu papel envolve não apenas a liderança técnica, mas também o desenvolvimento e mentoria da equipe, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade que impulsionem os resultados do negócio.


Como será seu dia a dia?

Você liderará o time na arquitetura e desenvolvimento de soluções e-commerce utilizando VTEX IO, tomando decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, padrões de desenvolvimento e melhores práticas. Realizará code reviews, garantindo a qualidade e manutenibilidade do código, enquanto mentora desenvolvedores em suas jornadas de crescimento profissional. Participará ativamente de reuniões com áreas de negócio, product managers e stakeholders, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas claras e viáveis. Atuará na remoção de impedimentos técnicos, coordenará sprints e cerimônias ágeis, e promoverá a adoção de novas tecnologias que agreguem valor ao produto. Será também o ponto focal para discussões técnicas complexas e alinhamento estratégico entre tecnologia e objetivos corporativos.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida com a plataforma VTEX (VTEX IO, Store Framework), incluindo customização de componentes, desenvolvimento de apps e integrações.
  • Domínio de React, TypeScript, Node.js e GraphQL para desenvolvimento de soluções frontend e backend na plataforma VTEX.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de e-commerce, incluindo integrações com sistemas de pagamento, logística, ERP e outras plataformas de terceiros.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica de times de desenvolvimento, incluindo mentoria, orientação e gestão de entregas.
  • Histórico de tomada de decisões técnicas estratégicas, definindo padrões de código, arquitetura e escolha de tecnologias.
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas e vice-versa.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e experiência na condução de cerimônias e processos de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git/GitHub) e pipelines de CI/CD para ambientes VTEX.
  • Capacidade de identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance, otimizando a experiência do usuário e conversão.
  • Habilidade de promover um ambiente colaborativo, gerenciar conflitos e desenvolver autonomia no time.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir certificação oficial VTEX (VTEX Certified Developer ou similares).
  • Tiver experiência com outras plataformas de e-commerce (Shopify, Magento, SAP Commerce) e conseguir fazer análises comparativas.
  • Conhecer Faststore, a nova arquitetura headless da VTEX, e suas aplicações em projetos de alta performance.
  • Tiver vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento (New Relic, Datadog, Splunk) em ambientes e-commerce.
  • Conhecer práticas avançadas de SEO técnico e otimização de conversão (CRO) aplicadas a e-commerce.
  • Tiver experiência com arquiteturas headless, composable commerce e APIs modernas (REST, GraphQL).
  • Possuir formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Demonstrar histórico de contribuições em comunidades técnicas, palestras ou artigos sobre e-commerce e VTEX.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer


Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:


  • We are building a team to work on the FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) framework, including hwmon, libpmc, and pmcstat.
  • The project includes development, testing, and cooperation with the upstream FreeBSD open-source community to integrate new features into FreeBSD.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and improve parts of the FreeBSD PMC framework (hwmon, libpmc, pmcstat)
  • Investigate and fix performance and monitoring issues in the FreeBSD kernel
  • Work with the upstream FreeBSD community and integrate changes into mainline FreeBSD
  • Support performance monitoring tools for modern AMD (Zen era) hardware
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7 years of experience in relevant technical areas
  • Strong knowledge of FreeBSD kernel architecture and internals
  • Excellent C programming skills
  • Strong understanding of x86 microarchitecture
  • Very good knowledge of performance monitoring on modern x86 systems


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Previous contributions to upstream FreeBSD kernel code
  • Experience with AMD Zen performance monitoring technologies (PMC, IBS, etc.)

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.


Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $14,000 – $18,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English required, with familiarity in French

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP


We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required; fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required; fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto.   • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;

title: Java Kafka Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience in Java distributed systems and streambased processing to join our engineering team You will design build and operate backend services that handle highthroughput workloads integrate with cloud platforms and support businesscritical applications

This role also involves working with Nodejs services CICD pipelines and modern infrastructure tooling including Kubernetes GitHub Actions AWS and GCP

Responsibilities Include

This is a critical role with a wide range of responsibilities including

Design implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Nodejs

Build and optimize messagedriven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Working Hours: 9am–5pm EST (some flexibility)

Openings: 3

Contract Duration: 8-month contract with potential extensions

Structure: CLT (non-negotiable)

Start Date: April 6th, 2026

Interview Process: 2 rounds!


Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience


Compensation & Benefits

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.
